$comment: Escalation policy definitions for scripts/alerts/escalate.mjs. Dependency-free JSON — edit by hand, no build step. Each policy is an ordered chain of levels (L1 on-call -> L2 -> L3). Semantics: when an incident is triggered, level 1 is notified immediately. If the incident is not acknowledged within that level's `ackTimeoutMinutes`, the next level is notified, and so on. `ackSlaMinutes` is the promised acknowledgement time shown to responders (should be <= ackTimeoutMinutes). After the final level's ackTimeoutMinutes elapses, the engine either re-notifies the final level every `repeatIntervalMinutes` (if set) or marks the incident 'exhausted' and stays silent until ack/resolve. `notify.webhook` (default true) controls whether the engine POSTs the escalation payload to ALERT_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL / --webhook; `notify.email`/`notify.pager` are documentation hints for the receiving system, not delivered by this script. Routing from alert sources/rule ids to policy names lives in docs/alerts/routing.json.

db-critical.title: Database monitor — critical
db-critical.description: Critical database-monitoring rule firing (connection pool saturation, disk usage, failed migrations, backup staleness) or a monitor 'error' status. Data-loss/corruption class — page fast.

chain.name: secondary on-call / DB owner
chain.role: secondary on-call engineer or database owner

db-warning.title: Database monitor — warning
db-warning.description: Warning-severity database-monitoring rule (idle-in-transaction, long queries, replication lag, dead tuples). Degraded state, not yet user-facing.

deploy-critical.title: Deploy — failed / rolled back
deploy-critical.description: A production (or staging) deploy reported 'failed' or 'rolled-back' via scripts/deploy/notify.ts. The site may be down or on a bad revision.

chain.name: release on-call
chain.role: on-call engineer owning the release pipeline

deploy-warning.title: Deploy — attention
deploy-warning.description: Non-fatal deploy signal routed here when a deployment reports something noteworthy that is not a hard failure (e.g. a started event used as a heartbeat in custom pipelines).

perf-critical.title: Performance budget — critical breach
perf-critical.description: Lighthouse budget assertion failed at 'error' level (scripts/lighthouse/summarize.mjs --check). User-facing performance regression.

perf-warning.title: Performance budget — warning breach
perf-warning.description: Lighthouse budget assertion failed at 'warn' level. Regression is real but not yet release-blocking.

secrets-critical.title: Secrets — critical
secrets-critical.description: Possible secret exposure or failed secret-store validation (scripts/secrets scan/check/rotation). Treat as a security incident until proven otherwise.

secrets-warning.title: Secrets — warning
secrets-warning.description: Secret hygiene finding that is not an active exposure (e.g. rotation overdue, missing non-production variable).

generic-critical.title: Unclassified alert — critical
generic-critical.description: Catch-all for critical-severity events from sources with no more specific routing.

generic-warning.title: Unclassified alert — warning
generic-warning.description: Catch-all for warning-severity events from sources with no more specific routing.
